combos.title: 光影壳 + 线框立方体 + 演示稿
combos.summary: Ambient CSS 的物理光照页当壳，Wireframe Forms · Cube 当面板装饰，对照官方演示文稿设计师从主模板出稿。全员课先看这三件怎么配，不编指标。
combos.summaryEn: Ambient CSS as the lighting shell, Wireframe Forms · Cube as panel ornament, and the official Presentation Designer working from a master template. An all-hands kit — how the three pieces sit together, no invented metrics.

combos.title: OpenDesign + 表单地基 + 上线小组
combos.summary: OpenDesign 本机出页，shadcn/ui 当 Agent 拼界面的默认组件/表单库，对照官方 Website Launch 多 Bot 小组。Design 工作室用；发布仍停在人这边。
combos.summaryEn: OpenDesign for a local-first page, shadcn/ui as the Agent’s default form/component kit, and the official Website Launch multi-bot group. A Design-studio pick; publish still stops with a human.

combos.title: Refero 方向 + Sketchbook + figma bro
combos.summary: 贴一份 Refero DESIGN.md 当方向，Sketchbook 当落地页骨架，figma bro 走真实组件库改稿。口味判断必须人做。
combos.summaryEn: Paste one Refero DESIGN.md as direction, use Sketchbook as the landing skeleton, and let figma bro edit through a real component library. Taste judgment stays human.

combos.title: MotionSites + 结构流 + 无代码小队
combos.summary: MotionSites 的落地页提示当壳，Structure Flow 当三维场，对照 How Do I Use AI 的四周小队 rollout。全员课只配这三件；先一任务，再谈 skill。
combos.summaryEn: MotionSites landing prompts as the shell, Structure Flow as the 3D field, and How Do I Use AI’s four-week team rollout. An all-hands kit of three pieces — one task first, then a skill.
